run_clip_token_lengths: run the script to compute CLIP token lengths for localized narratives on train and valid splits
get_clip_token_lengths_split: get CLIP token lengths and caption counts for a specific localized narratives data split
summarize_token_stats: summarize token statistics for localized narratives captions filtered by a 76 token threshold
review_split_mapping: review the split mapping logic that converts train/valid to coco_train/coco_val dataset names
test_token_filtering: test the token length filtering that skips captions exceeding 76 tokens in localized narratives
